skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand basic terms and concepts related to finance, money, banking, financial system, national budget, corporate finance, credit, interest rates, and financial markets.
Analyze the relationship between components of the financial system.
Analyze differences between various types of corporate assets and sources of capital.
Analyze differences between various parts of the financial market.
Apply theoretical knowledge to practical research on finance, money, and banking.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Decision Making Based on Financial Calculations
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Use calculations of interest rates and time value of money to make investment decisions.
Discuss measures to address budget deficits and analyze their pros and cons.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Risk and Return Analysis for Investment Portfolios
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Analyze risks and returns using characteristics of financial instruments to choose investment portfolios.
Develop independent work skills, dynamic and diverse teamwork skills, and presentation skills.
